term: objective as actual truth plus specified profile stability
definition: ActualStableDefinition f means ∀ s, objective s ↔ (holds actual s ∧ Stable f s). It is a proposed calibration of an independent predicate, so it can fail.
note: Analyst extensional sibling of the legacy attitude-independence gloss, not an adopted definition or an attribution to O’Connor. Whether stability under these profiles captures philosophical attitude independence remains open. It entails the truth-component bridge, but that weaker bridge suffices for the external-evil composition.
